evals.prompt: OrderReport.RecentAsync is slow on the dashboard. Optimize the EF Core query so it no longer issues one query per order.
evals.expected_output: N+1 query loading patterns are replaced with eager loading or projections.
expectations: The N+1 pattern (one OrderItems query per order) is identified as the cause
The query is rewritten as a single projection (Select into OrderSummary) or eager load (Include) so it issues one round trip
The read-only path avoids change tracking (projection or AsNoTracking)
The resulting SQL or query count is inspected or explained (for example ToQueryString or logging)
